title: Temporal Arbitrage Task
description: Schema for task tracking within the Temporal Arbitrage Engine. Covers time-sensitivity scoring, batch eligibility, deferral history, and energy-type alignment.

category.description: Primary category for grouping and batch detection.

tags.description: Freeform tags for fine-grained grouping. Used by the batch detector to cluster tasks with overlapping tags.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the task was created.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the task deadline. Null if no hard deadline exists.

effort_hours.description: Estimated effort in hours to complete the task.

urgency_score.description: Computed urgency score from the time-scorer. Range 0 (no urgency) to 100 (critical).

time_sensitivity.description: How the task's urgency changes over time. Appreciating tasks become more expensive to delay; depreciating tasks become cheaper when batched later.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

deferrals.description: History of deferrals. Three or more entries trigger a procrastination alert.

date.description: ISO 8601 date when the task was deferred.

dependencies.description: Task IDs that this task depends on. Also used to calculate dependency boost in scoring: tasks that block many others receive priority.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the task was completed. Null while incomplete.

energy_type.description: Energy level required to perform this task effectively. Used by chronotype optimization to align tasks with the user's energy curve throughout the day.

batch_eligible.description: Whether this task can be grouped with similar tasks for batch processing. Typically true for low-urgency, context-similar work.

opportunity_cost_per_hour.description: Estimated dollar value lost per hour this task remains undone. Used by the opportunity cost calculator to compare alternatives. Null if not quantifiable.

notes.description: Free-text notes, context, or links related to the task.
